name: NIST SP 800-218, Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1: Recommendations for Mitigating the Risk of Software Vulnerabilities
description: NIST SP 800-218 (SSDF) v1.1 is a voluntary, outcome-based secure-software-development framework of 19 practices / 42 tasks across four groups (PO Prepare the Organization, PS Protect the Software, PW Produce Well-Secured Software, RV Respond to Vulnerabilities), referenced by EO 14028 and the OMB self-attestation regime; v1.1 (Feb 2022) remains current while SP 800-218 Rev. 1 (SSDF v1.2) sits in draft (IPD Dec 2025, comments closed Jan 2026) and the AI companion SP 800-218A was finalized Jul 2024.
